Recipe.name: Cheesy Scrambled Eggs
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 24 SERVINGS: FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE / RANGE-TOP METHOD: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350F. 2. Coat flat-top griddle or sauté pan(s) over medium heat with cooking spray. Add egg. Sprinkle cheese on top of eggs. 3. Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are set but still soft and the cheese has melted. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. FOR 6 SERVINGS: FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE / RANGE-TOP METHOD: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350F. 2. Coat flat-top griddle or sauté pan(s) over medium heat with cooking spray. Add 2 cups egg (1# 2 ozw) Sprinkle 6-oz spoodle cheese on top of eggs. 3. Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are set but still soft and the cheese has melted. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Smoked Maple Sausage
Recipe.assembly_instructions: OVEN METHOD 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. On parchment-lined sheet pan(s), place sausage slices. 3. Bake until internal temperature reaches 140 F, 4 to 6 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE METHOD 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook sausage 2 minutes. Turn sausage over. Cook until internal temperature reaches 140 F, 2 to 3 minutes. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Sausage Gravy
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium heat, bring gravy to a boil, 5 to 7 minutes. 2. Reduce heat. Simmer, stirring often, 5 minutes. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: UVA Buffalo-Style Chicken Wings
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Into 2-oz portion cups with lids, place 1 1/2 oz-ladle dressing. Keep chilled for service. 2. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 3. Fry frozen wings until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 180 F and juices run clear, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. 4. Combine wings and sauce. Toss to coat. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. On serving plate, place the following 5 coated wings 3 celery sticks 2 carrot sticks 1oz portion cup dressing 2. Serve immediately.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: UVA Boneless Chicken Wings
Recipe.assembly_instructions: Into portion cups, place 1 1/2 oz-ladle sauce. Cover. Keep chilled for service. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. Fry frozen chicken nuggets until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165 F, 3-4 minutes. Drain. For one serving: On serving plate, place the following: 6 chicken nuggets tossed in the sauce of the guest's choice Serve immediately.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: UVA Cajun Baked Chicken
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. FOR FROZEN CHICKEN 1. Coat chicken with cooking spray. 2. Place chicken and seasoning in a bowl. Toss to coat. 3. On sheet pan(s), place frozen chicken skin side up in single layer. 4. Bake until internal temperature reaches 180 F and juices run clear, 35 to 40 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. FOR THAWED CHICKEN: 1. Place chicken and seasoning in a bowl. Toss to coat. 2. On sheet pan(s), place chicken skin side up in single layer. 3. Bake until internal temperature reaches 180 F and juices run clear, 25 to 30 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Newcomb Egg & Cheese Croissant
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of 1 croissant: 1 Fried Egg 1 slice cheese Top half of croissant 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Seasoned Steamed Green Beans
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat steamer. 2. In 2" perforated steam table pan(s), steam frozen beans until tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain. 3. Combine green beans and seasoning. Toss to mix. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Zucchini & Tomatoes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Drain tomatoes, reserving liquid. 2. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion and pepper. Saute until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 3. Combine reserved liquid, cornstarch and sugar. Whisk until well blended. Add to vegetable mixture. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils, 2 to 3 minutes. 4. Add tomato and zucchini. Return to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until zucchini is tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Cilantro Lime Rice
Recipe.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD 1. In stockpot over high heat, bring water, lime juice, base and pepper to a boil. Add rice. Stir. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 2. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. 3. At time of service, stir in cilantro. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In 4" half steam table pan, place the following: 1 lb + 12 oz rice 1 qt + 3 cup boiling water 1/4 cup lime juice 1 1/4 oz base 1/2 tsp pepper Stir. Cover. 2. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. 4. At time of service, stir in 3 tbl cilantro.

Recipe.name: Crispy Catfish
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine flour, biscuit mix, cornmeal, salt, pepper and paprika. Whisk until well blended. 2. Into 2-oz portion cups with lids, place #30 scoop Tartar Sauce. Keep chilled for service. 3. Combine fish and Marinade. Turn to coat. 4. Place fish with Marinade in covered nonreactive shallow pan(s) or sealable plastic bag(s). Refrigerate 1 hour. 5. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 6. Drain fish. Discard Marinade. 7. Dredge fish in seasoned flour. Shake off excess. 8. Fry fish until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 145 F, 4 to 6 minutes. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. On serving plate, place the following: 1 piece fish 1 portion cup Tartar Sauce 2. Serve immediately.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full. IDDSI Level 7

Recipe.name: Salisbury Steak & Mushroom Sauce
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In saute pan over medium heat, bring onion, water, base and granulated garlic to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Cool. 2. Preheat convection oven to 300 F. 3. In mixer bowl with paddle attachment, combine ground beef, ground turkey, bread crumbs, egg, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt, ground black pepper, thyme and onion mixture. Mix on low speed until well combined, 3 to 4 minutes. DO NOT OVERMIX. 4. Using a level #8 scoop, portion out meat mixture. Shape each portion into an oval patty, 1/2" thick. 5. On parchment-lined sheet pan(s), place patties 1" apart. 6. Bake until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 25 to 30 minutes. Drain. 7. Cover. Keep hot for service. 8. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add mushroom. Saute until tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Add garlic. Saute 30 seconds. 9. Add Gravy. Whisk until well blended. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 3 minutes. 10. Cover. Keep hot for service. TO PLATE 1 SERVING: 1. On serving plate, layer the following: 1 steak 3-oz ladle sauce 1/2 tsp parsley 2. Serve immediately.

Recipe.name: Mac & Cheese
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, melt butter. Add flour, salt, mustard and pepper. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking often, 4 minutes. DO NOT BROWN. 2. Add milk. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. Remove from heat. 3. Add American and cheddar cheeses, and hot sauce. Whisk until cheeses are melted. 4. Combine Hot Pasta and sauce. Toss to coat. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In 2" half steam table pan, place the following: 3 qt pasta mixture 2. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over high heat, bring water and milk to a boil. 2. Gradually add grits, whisking constantly, until mixture returns to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, whisking occasionally, 6 minutes. 3. Add remaining ingredients. Whisk until well blended. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Turkey Enchilada with Red Sauce
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, green pepper and garlic. Saute 3 minutes. 3. Stir in Turkey Burrito Filling, beans, tomato, chili powder, cumin, salt, hot sauce and black pepper. Saute until heated through. FOR 1 ENCHILADA (1 per serving): 1. Spread 4-oz spoodle turkey-bean mixture over lower half of 1 tortilla. Roll tortilla closed. FOR EACH 8 SERVINGS: 1. In 2" full steam table pan coated with cooking spray, layer the following: 4-oz ladle Enchilada Sauce 8 enchiladas, seam side down 4-oz ladle enchilada sauce Cover tightly with foil. 2. Bake until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove foil. Sprinkle each enchilada with 1 tbl cheese. 3. Bake until cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. FOR INDIVIDUAL CASSEROLES: 1. In specified individual ovenproof dish layer the following: 1 tbl Enchilada Sauce 1 enchilada 1 tbl enchilada sauce Cover tightly with foil. 2. Bake until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove foil. Sprinkle enchilada with 1 tbl cheese. 3. Bake until cheese is melted, 2 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion, celery, green pepper and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 2. Add flour. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. 4. Reduce heat. Simmer, stirring often, 5 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Add mushrooms, onion, garlic and thyme. Saute until mushrooms are tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 6. Add flour, salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until flour is golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in base. 7. Add water. wine and sugar. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. Reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in chopped parsley. 8. Cover. Keep hot. FOR EACH 24 SERVINGS: 1. In 2" full steam table pan, place 24 baked chicken breasts in single layer. Pour 1 qt + 2 cups sauce over chicken breasts in pan. 2. Cover. Keep hot for service. Recipe.name: Whole Grain Garlic Toast

Recipe.name: Bacon
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 325 F. 2. On full sheet pan(s), place bacon layouts, paper-side down, in single layer. 3. Bake until golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. 4. Remove from paper. Drain. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Home Fries
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to coat. 3. On sheet pan(s), spread potato mixture in thin layer. 4. Bake until potatoes are tender and golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: O'Brien Potatoes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Coat griddle with oil. Add onion, green pepper and red pepper. Saute until peppers are tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 3. Add potatoes, salt and pepper. Cook until potatoes are tender and golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat steamer. 2. In perforated steam table pan(s), steam potatoes until fork-tender, 15 to 20 minutes. 3. Combine milk and butter. Heat to 140 F. 4. In mixer bowl with whisk attachment, beat potatoes on low speed until no lumps remain, 2 to 3 minutes. 5. Add milk mixture, scallions, salt and pepper. Mix until well blended. DO NOT OVERMIX. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Garlic Mashed Sweet Potatoes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat steamer. 2. In perforated steam table pan(s), steam potatoes until fork-tender, 25 to 30 minutes. 3. Combine milk, butter and Roasted Garlic. Heat to 140 F. Mix until well blended. 4. In mixer bowl with whisk attachment, beat potatoes on low speed until no lumps remain, 2 to 3 minutes. 5. Add milk mixture, salt and pepper. Mix until well blended. Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to coat. 3. On sheet pan(s), place potatoes in single layer. 4. Bake, turning once, until golden brown and fork-tender, 16 to 22 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.
